facts.fact: 她从礁石上被一双手拖起来；雾里以为看见 Helen 在岸边挥手，也可能她根本没在
facts.anchor: I feel arms hauling me up from the slick rocks.

facts.fact: 她在陌生的床上醒来，左髋有伤，伤口上涂着药膏——那人趁她睡着时替她上过药
facts.anchor: The man has been tending to me, touching my bare hip while I slept.

facts.fact: 他说「That hip needs to heal」「Nae where yer supposed to be」
facts.anchor: Nae where yer supposed to be.

facts.fact: 她认出他：记忆里三十五六岁，如今该五十多，却一点没变
她问有没有船，他说几年前一场大风里丢了
facts.anchor: Lost it to a bad gale some years ago.

facts.fact: 他趁她睡着取走了她脖子上的挂坠；他说当年有个小女孩偷了它，那女孩「才一年前来过」
facts.anchor: The girl was here only a year ago.

facts.fact: 她答「It was twenty years ago.」；他自报 Clay，她说「I know.」
他把她从岸边带上来已经两天
facts.anchor: Been two days since I brought ye up from the shore.

facts.fact: 客厅壁炉上的木钟停着，指针停在 11:42
他给她的干净衣服是他亡妻的
facts.anchor: These clothes belonged to his wife.
